long_biography.plain_text:
Roland Dickey Jr. grew up in the third generation of a Dallas barbecue family, learning slow-smoking methods from his father, Roland Sr. After earning a business-administration degree at Southern Methodist University and gaining experience with other restaurant companies, he joined Dickey’s in 1999. He worked through management roles before becoming chief executive.

Dickey inherited an established regional franchise rather than founding the brand. He made national scale the central strategy, investing in technology, marketing, real estate support, logistics and field operations. The chain expanded beyond Texas and later moved internationally. He subsequently created Dickey’s Capital Group to oversee restaurants alongside food manufacturing, retail products, technology and property interests, while restaurant leadership passed to his wife, Laura Rea Dickey.
